description: Add a message to one of this account's own support tickets; human support staff answer it, never an AI. Returns object ticket.reply with the ticket as support recorded it. Replies come later: read them with everyinfra_tickets and the same ticket_id. Without idempotency_key, the same message to the same ticket is sent once per UTC day, so a retry does not post it twice. Example: {"ticket_id": 42, "message": "Still failing for request_id req_abc123, see the error above."}. Needs the support:write account scope, which is off by default and can only be granted by the account owner in the console.

idempotency_key.description: Optional, 8-128 letters, digits or _.:@-; keep it when retrying

message.description: Plain text, 1-4000 characters; include request_id values when relevant

ticket_id.description: Ticket number from everyinfra_tickets or everyinfra_ticket_create

name: everyinfra_ticket_reply
title: Reply to a support ticket
